meta.title: Repository-side academic verification of review-pending resources
meta.scope: The three new review-pending Development resources for OCR AS Level Economics (H060) topic 2.2 (site order 4.2): study guide, revision notes and practice questions
meta.method: Each resource read in full and checked against the OCR AS Level Economics (H060) Version 3.0 (June 2026) specification text, section 2d (Component 2, H060/02), topic 2.2 Development, for specification identity, coverage of all four 2.2 statements, accuracy at AS level, terminology, cross-board isolation, originality and placeholders. Mark tariffs compared with marking points, following the multi-part total convention of sibling H060 practice pages. Every numerical worked example and answer recomputed in Python. Internal /resources/ links checked against existing files. Factual claims (Brundtland 1987 definition, 17 SDGs 2015-2030, UK net zero 2050, HDI dimensions and UNDP method, UK services share of output) checked against public official sources: UN, UNDP, legislation.gov.uk and ONS. No error found, so no edits were made; enrichment beyond spec wording recorded as minor open issues.
meta.whatThisIsNot: Not a teacher review and not a sign-off. No reviewStatus, reviewer, reviewedDate, author or publishedDate was changed. Every resource here remains review-pending until a named, authorised Marlbridge reviewer accepts it under the editorial policy.

outcomes.VERIFIED_AFTER_CORRECTION: errors found and corrected in this programme
outcomes.PARTIAL_UNVERIFIABLE: no error found, but material claims could not be checked against a public official source (typically licensed IB guide content or blocked board pages)

openIssues.description: Natural-capital-adjusted growth and relative versus absolute decoupling are not named in Version 3.0 topic 2.2; correct and relevant to evaluating growth and sustainable development, but enrichment beyond spec wording.

The simplified HDI (linear income, 0-50,000 goalposts, arithmetic mean, education index from expected years only) is clearly labelled as not the official method; the spec does not require an HDI calculation. The official method is described correctly in the next paragraph.
SDGs (17 goals, 2015 to 2030) and UK net zero 2050 are context beyond the spec wording; both verified correct.
